lead.title: CuspAI raises $450M Series B at $2.6B valuation for AI-driven materials discovery
lead.summary: CuspAI closed a $450M Series B led by Kleiner Perkins and NEA, with participation from Bezos Expeditions, AMD Ventures, and Lux Capital. The AI materials science startup focuses on discovering novel compounds for semiconductors, energy storage, and climate applications, with Nvidia and Samsung joining as strategic partners.

top_stories.title: Sereact closes $116M Series B for AI-powered warehouse robotics with Zalando as strategic investor
top_stories.summary: The warehouse robotics startup raised $116M with Zalando joining as a strategic investor alongside Headline, Air Street Capital, and Creandum. Over 200 systems are live across Europe with 1B+ production picks completed.

top_stories.title: Natural raises $30M Series A to reinvent payments for AI agents
top_stories.summary: The startup raised $30M led by Forerunner's Kirsten Green to build AI-native payment infrastructure for autonomous agents, handling transactions, checkouts, and disputes without human involvement.

items.title: RynnBrain 1.1: Embodied foundation model family achieves SOTA across multiple benchmarks
items.summary: Alibaba's RynnBrain 1.1 family (2B, 9B, 122B-A10B) uses a unified spatio-temporal framework. The 122B-A10B variant outperforms all proprietary and open-source models on VSI-Bench, MMSI, and RefSpatial-Bench. Real-robot experiments show RynnBrain-initialized policies outperform Qwen-based and generalist VLA baselines.

items.title: Partially correlated verifier cascades: LLM reliability decays polynomially, not exponentially
items.summary: A formal theory of correlated verifier cascades shows log-odds are concave in gate count, failure decays polynomially, and blind-spot atoms cap reliability. Independence-based extrapolation underestimates failure by 20x at k=5 and ~3000x at k=10.

items.title: Agon introduces competitive cross-model RL with implicit rival grading
items.summary: Two models grade each other's reasoning traces without process labels. On DeepMath with Qwen3, the approach doubles GRPO's pass@1. The method replicates across Qwen3.5 and Gemma 4 on competitive programming tasks.

items.title: GEPO: Group entropy-controlled policy optimization extends GRPO for heterogeneous tasks
items.summary: A lightweight GRPO extension using group entropy for entropy-conditioned asymmetric advantage shaping. Consistently outperforms GRPO and recent entropy-controlled methods across 13 benchmarks spanning math, physics, code, and instruction following.

items.title: RESOURCE2SKILL distills executable agent skills from multimodal human resources
items.summary: Microsoft Research presents a framework that distills tutorials, repositories, and articles into executable skills for software agents, organized as a hierarchical Skill Wiki. Improves average score by +11.9 percentage points over no-skill agents.

items.title: Kimi Work launches as a next-gen desktop AI agent for knowledge workers
items.summary: Moonshot AI's Kimi Work automates workflows, organizes files, and operates across the web with 300 specialized agents for financial research, analysis, and office tasks.

items.title: SHACKLE: Deterministic runtime governance for AI agents
items.summary: An open-source governance protocol and policy-decision daemon enforcing guardrails, budget and loop limits in real time through an audited decision engine built on SP-1.

items.title: Relay: Self-hosted LLM gateway with eval-gated routing in a single static binary
items.summary: Supports OpenAI and Anthropic API dialects with any provider as backend, zero telemetry, and eval-gated routing policies — all in a single binary with no external dependencies.

items.title: Agent Search Engine catalogs 247 verified AI agents and MCP servers
items.summary: A searchable directory of hundreds of AI agents, MCP servers, and frameworks including coding, voice, browser, and autonomous agents. Independently verified and refreshed weekly.

items.title: Nativ runs frontier open models locally on Apple Silicon
items.summary: Free and open-source app running language, vision, video, code, and embedding models locally on Mac. No accounts, subscriptions, or cloud required.

items.title: Infinity raises $15M seed at $100M valuation for universal AI inference software
items.summary: Building a universal inference library to run AI models on any chip, challenging Nvidia's CUDA dominance. Backed by Touring Capital and researchers from OpenAI and Anthropic.

items.title: Colossal Biosciences reportedly in talks to raise new capital at $20B-$30B valuation
items.summary: The AI-driven de-extinction biotech is in talks for new funding at a valuation of $20B-$30B, up from $10.2B in 2025. The UAE recently invested $60M.

items.title: Skyfall AI emerges from stealth with Fidelity backing to build autonomous enterprise systems
items.summary: Founded by ex-Microsoft Maluuba team and backed by Fidelity, Inovia Capital, and Touring Capital. Building what it calls the world's first autonomous enterprise AI system.
